title: Effect of Pyridostigmine (Mestinon) on Muscle Strength in Myasthenia Gravis
brief_summary: A randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blinded cross-over study evaluating and quantifying the effect of pyridostigmine on muscle strength and symptoms in Myasthenia Gravis (MG)
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* MG verified by a) anti-body, or b) single-fiber EMG and/or decrement on ENG.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Anti-MuSK
* Known cardio-pulmonary disease
* Known neuropathy
* Known myopathy
* Known malignant disease
* Pregnancy or breastfeeding
* Mechanic ileus, urinary tract obstruction, peritonitis

De-novo MG Eligibility Criteria

* MG diagnosis \< 2 months, no prior antimyasthenic medications

Chronic MG Eligibility Criteria

* MG diagnosis \> 1 year, and stable pyridostigmine dosis
